coverage_protocol.full_read_rule: Actual model-visible segmented reading is required. Export/hash/script completion alone does not prove model full-read.
coverage_protocol.segment_guidance: Prefer 80-120 logical lines per visible segment; reduce if the harness truncates.
coverage_protocol.truncation_rule: Continue from first uncovered position until union coverage reaches EOF. Unrecoverable truncation => BLOCKED.

duplicate_guard.found_active: STOP / do not create a second run
duplicate_guard.found_stopped: preserve STOP and return to Designer
duplicate_guard.prohibited_inference: No same-named branch/ref does not prove global nonexistence.
duplicate_guard.scope: this exact SUPP-02 v0.2.1 run only

evidence_reuse.principle: Reuse only sufficiently bound factual evidence; never inherit an aggregate PASS verdict.
evidence_reuse.required_failure_rule: If a claim is necessary for the current verdict and cannot be sufficiently verified, mark NOT_VERIFIED and BLOCK.

execution.data_policy: Only task-required repository docs/objects/diffs/evidence. Do not read production secrets or private account/trading data. Do not call paid external providers for proof.

reviewer_forbidden_authority: modify subject candidate or frozen truth

human_authority.freeze_readiness_effect: Missing original Human carrier prevents Human Freeze Readiness from becoming READY by this review alone, while independently provable byte/path facts may still pass.
human_authority.missing_carrier: If unavailable, report SOURCE_AUTHORITY_NOT_VERIFIED. Do not reconstruct it from dev_log, PROJECT_STATE, current continue instructions, or executor reports.
human_authority.original_carrier: If the original Human Content Confirmation / Whitespace Amendment carrier is directly accessible, read and bind it.
human_authority.recorded_confirmation: Repository records of CONFIRMED may be reported as repository-recorded facts.

v0_2_1_new_prospective_completion.normalization: Historical T/AC naming is normalized to complete T-01..T-10 and AC-01..AC-10. This is prospective successor semantics, not a claim that v0.1 already contained 10/10 definitions.

v0_2_preserved.hidden_runtime_metadata: NOT_EXPOSED alone is not a blocker
v0_2_preserved.runtime_semantics: Routing Recommendation != Resolved Execution Profile != Runtime Attestation

time_hash_source_rules.current_run_time: Record actual UTC start/end and derived local time with full date/offset from the same instant.
time_hash_source_rules.hash_layers: Separate historical embedded hashes, exact source-object hashes, and newly recomputed final output hashes. Do not claim a stale internal hash was correct for a prior version unless those prior bytes exist.
time_hash_source_rules.historical_time: Separate source-declared time, mathematical conversion, and proof of actual event time. Unknown historical actual time remains NOT_VERIFIED.

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: A unique v0.2.1 run is established; reviewer role/process independence and Fresh Context are established; resolved model/harness/effort/tools/permissions are recorded truthfully; harness-hidden runtime metadata is labeled NOT_EXPOSED rather than invented.
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: Current Workflow main and current MarketPulse authority main are live-verified at start/end; the exact persistence subject commit/tree/sole parent are independently verified; registration/currentness and subject-baseline identities are explicitly separated with no stale substitution.
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: All mandatory full-read inputs are actually read to EOF with recoverable, machine-checkable coverage: current MarketPulse PROJECT_STATE, required historical subject-state context, Frozen A-D, complete Requirement, Design Review transcript, persistence dev_log, and complete candidate PROJECT_STATE; no unrecovered truncation remains.
acceptance_criteria.AC-04: Exact persistence fidelity is established: six-path set equality, modes/types, Requirement/transcript byte identities, 11 allowed trailing-space lines only, append-only state carriers, Frozen A-D identity, and zero outside-scope product/code/schema/runtime delta.
acceptance_criteria.AC-05: Every reused evidence claim has checkable identity/provenance/sufficiency; original PR/AC mapping is complete; required current claims do not rely on inherited aggregate PASS; any non-rerun item is labeled NOT_RERUN rather than silently PASS.
acceptance_criteria.AC-06: F-SUPP-01 / NB-04 is assessed from authoritative text and full context; all seven NB-04 questions are answered; NB-01..NB-04 remain OPEN; no 'before Freeze' timing requirement is weakened, deferred, or replaced by FREEZE PENDING.
acceptance_criteria.AC-07: Historical time/source/hash facts and current-run facts are strictly separated; original Human authority limitations remain explicit; SOURCE_AUTHORITY_NOT_VERIFIED is preserved where applicable and no Human authorization is inferred from dev_log, PROJECT_STATE, or a continue instruction.
acceptance_criteria.AC-08: Execution-evidence semantics are correct: Routing Recommendation != Resolved Execution Profile != Runtime Attestation; hidden runtime model/effort metadata absence alone does not block, while real reviewer-role conflict, Fresh Context failure, required-input absence, or insufficient evidence does block.
acceptance_criteria.AC-09: Repository mutation is zero; complete external deliverables exist with real coverage, command logs, raw exact-object evidence, detached hashes and a bundle manifest; outputs do not fabricate self-hashes or retroactive historical logs; no Gate is advanced.
acceptance_criteria.AC-10: T-01..T-10 all satisfy their definitions, current persistence Blocking Findings = 0, and no required current claim is NOT_VERIFIED. PASS result is exactly FOCUSED_SUPPLEMENT_PASS / READY_FOR_DESIGNER_CLOSURE_ASSESSMENT. Human Freeze Readiness remains a separate determination and PASS does not close R01, Freeze the Requirement, or authorize implementation.

T-01.definition: Establish exactly one v0.2.1 run; check ACTIVE/TERMINAL/STOPPED duplicates; establish reviewer role/process independence; record ResolvedExecutionProfile and only harness-exposed runtime attestation; verify workspace/permission preflight. Hidden runtime model/reasoning metadata being unavailable alone is NOT a blocker.
T-01.name: Run Identity / Duplicate Guard / Reviewer Independence / Execution Profile

T-02.definition: At start and end, resolve live Workflow main and current MarketPulse authority main; separately verify the exact persistence subject branch/commit/tree/sole parent. Full-load Bootstrap, Manifest, all dynamically REQUIRED_ACTIVE rules, complete Workflow PROJECT_STATE and active routing profile. Build a Fresh Context Pack from authorized inputs only.
T-02.name: Current Authority Binding / Governance Load / Fresh Context

T-03.definition: Read the complete current MarketPulse PROJECT_STATE.md to EOF from current authority main, while separately reading the historical subject-baseline PROJECT_STATE object required to assess the persistence candidate. Record actual coverage, object identity, bytes/lines/hash and EOF. Current authority main and subject baseline MUST NOT be conflated.
T-03.name: Current MarketPulse State Full Read

T-04.definition: Read Frozen Authority A-D in full to EOF from exact fixed objects; record actual coverage and independently verify the same paths/blobs/modes in the persistence subject context. Separate BODY_FULL_READ from BLOB_IDENTITY_EQUALITY; one does not imply the other.
T-04.name: Frozen Authority A-D Full Read and Identity

T-05.definition: For each reused claim, bind source identity, provenance, exact input, section/field/range, what it proves and what it does not prove. Map original PR-01..PR-18 and historical AC-P01..P05 / AC-S01..S06 into ORIGINAL_REPORTED / SUPP-01_REPORTED / SUPP-02_CURRENT_ASSESSMENT / EVIDENCE / LIMIT. Historical aggregate PASS text is never inherited as a current verdict.
T-05.name: Evidence Reuse Qualification / Historical PR-AC Mapping

T-06.definition: Using full context, evaluate current Gate/state and NB-01..NB-04. Reassess F-SUPP-01 and NB-04 against the full transcript, Requirement timing language, Frozen authority and candidate state. Explicitly answer all required NB-04 questions. Preserve NB-01..NB-04 OPEN unless another authorized task later closes them.
T-06.name: Gate / State / NB / F-SUPP-01 / NB-04 Assessment

T-07.definition: Separate source-declared time, mathematically converted time, and independently proven actual run time; keep unproven historical run times NOT_VERIFIED. Separate historical embedded hashes from recomputed final hashes. Separate repository-recorded Human confirmations from independently available original Human carriers; missing original carriers remain SOURCE_AUTHORITY_NOT_VERIFIED and cannot be reconstructed from dev_log/PROJECT_STATE.
T-07.name: Time / Source / Hash / Human Authority Separation

T-08.definition: Verify STRICT READ_ONLY throughout: zero repository writes, no fetch/checkout/reset/rebase/merge/stash/clean/branch/worktree creation, no Freeze/Authorization/Implementation/Acceptance/Main Integration. Produce complete out-of-repository Result/Evidence/Coverage/segments/commands/raw/bundle outputs and STOP after verdict.
T-08.name: Review Boundary / Mutation / Delivery / STOP

T-09.definition: Independently verify the persistence candidate topology and exact six-path delta; path type/mode/rename/delete/symlink/submodule constraints; Requirement and Design Review transcript byte identities; allowed 11-line trailing-space exception set; append-only state carrier behavior; Frozen A-D unchanged identity; zero product/code/schema/runtime delta outside the authorized persistence set.
T-09.name: Exact Persistence Fidelity

T-10.definition: Re-read end bindings; ensure every required current claim is VERIFIED_THIS_RUN or VERIFIED_BY_REUSED_EVIDENCE with sufficient provenance; no required current claim remains NOT_VERIFIED; current persistence Blocking Findings = 0 for PASS. Produce the Structured Result Envelope, Human Freeze Readiness as a separate field, Next Legal Gate, and STOP without closing R01 or advancing Freeze.
T-10.name: Consolidated Current Verdict / End Binding / Closure Boundary
